description: This file is a header file defining functions and structures related to handling command-line options for diff and merge operations within a version control system, likely Git. It contains function declarations and a struct, meant to be included in C source files that implement the described functionality.

methods.name: diff_merges_config
methods.description: Configures diff merges based on the provided string value.

methods.name: diff_merges_parse_opts
methods.description: Parses command-line options related to diff merges.

methods.name: diff_merges_suppress
methods.description: Suppresses diff merge processing for given rev_info.

methods.name: diff_merges_default_to_first_parent
methods.description: Sets the default diff merge behavior to the first parent.

methods.name: diff_merges_default_to_dense_combined
methods.description: Sets default diff merge to dense combined mode.

methods.name: diff_merges_set_dense_combined_if_unset
methods.description: Sets dense combined mode if it was not already set.

methods.name: diff_merges_setup_revs
methods.description: Initializes or configures revision info for diff merges.
